description: This file defines extension methods for the ControllerBase class in ASP.NET Core MVC, providing utility functions for handling authentication, error responses, and redirection.

classes.name: ControllerBaseExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ControllerBase to handle authentication responses, error status, and redirection.

methods.name: ChallengeOrForbid
methods.description: Returns an ActionResult that challenges or forbids based on user authentication status, with optional authentication schemes.

methods.name: InternalServerError
methods.description: Creates an ObjectResult with HTTP 500 status code, optionally including a value.

methods.name: LocalRedirect
methods.description: Redirects to a local URL, with optional URL escaping.

methods.name: Redirect
methods.description: Redirects to a specified URL, with optional URL escaping.
